steps.title: Ice, platforms and climbing
steps.body: Icy floors to slide on, ice blocks that slide on when pushed, ice walls that fire melts, moving platforms and lifts that carry you, and walls to climb while your stamina lasts (as in Ocarina of Time and Breath of the Wild): they are under Starter pack › Ice, platforms and climbing.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: An icy floor, an ice block and an ice wall
steps.body: Place an Icy floor 3 studs in front of the start, an Ice block on it near its start end, and an Ice wall across the way just past the far end of the floor (13 studs ahead), in line with the block.
steps.task: Place an Icy floor, an Ice block and an Ice wall.

steps.title: Slide on the ice, push the block
steps.body: Press Play and walk onto the icy floor: you are slow to get going, slow to stop, and slide on after you let go. Walk up behind the ice block, hold E (Grab) and push (W): it slides on by itself until the ice wall stops it.
steps.task: Press Play and push the ice block.

steps.title: A torch for the ice
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Hand torch on the ground to one side of the start (Starter pack › Fire and light), off the icy floor. Ice melts with fire.

steps.title: Melt the ice wall
steps.body: Press Play, walk over the Hand torch (it goes into item button 1, J), go to the ice wall and press J: it steams and melts away. A sword does nothing to ice. An Ice wall also melts in a beam of light: turn a mirror onto it.
steps.task: Press Play and melt the ice wall.

steps.title: A moving platform
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Moving platform off to the other side of the start. In the Scene view a line shows where it goes: 8 studs and back, waiting a second at each end. Change where in the Asset studio (Ice, moving and climbing › Moves).

steps.title: Ride it
steps.body: Press Play and jump onto the platform: it carries you there and back. A Lift goes up and down; a Switch lift only runs while it is on (logic can turn it on, like the Forest Temple’s lift that runs while its torches burn).
steps.task: Press Play and ride the moving platform.

steps.title: Climb anything
steps.body: Stop the game. In the Inspector’s Project tab set Climbing to Anything, with stamina (like Breath of the Wild; the default, Ladders and vines only, is like Ocarina of Time).

steps.title: A rock face
steps.body: Place a Rock face, a tall wall to climb, 4 studs ahead and off to the side.

steps.title: Climb the rock face
steps.body: Press Play, walk into the rock face and keep walking: you hold on. W climbs up, S down, A and D move along it. The stamina bar drains as you climb; Space is a climb jump (a quick hop up for a quarter of it). Out of stamina you let go and fall. At the top you pull yourself up over the edge. A Smooth wall cannot be climbed.
steps.task: Press Play and climb to the top of the rock face.

check.args: Over the top of the wall

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You slid on an icy floor, pushed an ice block until an ice wall stopped it, melted the wall with a torch, rode a moving platform, and climbed a rock face with stamina. Make your own in the Asset studio: Ice, moving and climbing › Ice (Slippery floor, Slides when pushed, Melts with), Moves (where to, how long, waits, Only when on), Not climbable.
